subject: general
question: What is the fear of spiders known as?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Arachnophobia**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The word **"Arachnophobia"** refers to an intense fear or phobia of spiders and other arachnids such as scorpions. (मकड़ियों का डर)

 

 
• **Example:** Jane's arachnophobia was so severe that she couldn't even look at a picture of a spider.

 

 

 
• **"Arachnophobia"** comes from the Greek words "arachne," meaning spider, and "phobos," meaning fear. (मकड़ी का डर)

 

 
• **Example:** Many people with arachnophobia take steps to ensure their homes are free of spiders.

 

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Arachnophobia**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hemophobia** (रक्त का डर): The fear of blood.

 

 
• **Example:** Tom couldn't watch the surgery on TV due to his hemophobia.

 

 

 
• **Claustrophobia** (संकीर्ण स्थानों का डर): The fear of confined or crowded spaces.

 

 
• **Example:** Being stuck in an elevator triggered her claustrophobia.

 

 

 
• **Acrophobia** (ऊंचाई का डर): The fear of heights.

 

 
• **Example:** He couldn't climb the ladder because of his acrophobia.
